title: Signal From Workspace
text: Import signal from MATLAB workspace, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Signal} sets Signal to import; {Sample time} sets the output sample period, {Samples per frame}, {Form output after final data value by} sets the values to output after final imported signal value Setting and {Warn when frame size does not evenly divide input length} sets the warn when input length is not an integer multiple of frame. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Signal imported from workspace scalar | vector | matrix | 3-D array

params.name: Signal
params.values: Signal to import 1:10 (default) | MATLAB workspace variable | MATLAB expression

params.name: Form output after final data value by
params.values: Values to output after final imported signal value Setting to zero (default) | Holding final value | Cyclic repetition

params.name: Warn when frame size does not evenly divide input length
params.values: Warn when input length is not an integer multiple of frame size off (default) | on
